description: Analog shift register: a chain of four sample-and-holds, each clock edge passing every held voltage one stage further along

inputs.text: The voltage sampled on each clock edge
A rising edge samples the input into the first stage and moves every held voltage one stage along

outputs.text: The voltage sampled at the most recent clock edge
The voltage sampled one clock edge before the most recent
The voltage sampled two clock edges before the most recent
The voltage sampled three clock edges before the most recent, the oldest one the register holds
